form_General_Ue_Fs_Us.IPv4_show_hide: DHCP Server: Start/End IP Address + Lease Time (days/hours) chi BAT (khong disabled) khi ipv4Settings.dhcp.enabled=true. KHONG co truong DNS tren giao dien (xem duoi).
IPv6_show_hide: ipv6Settings.enabled=false -> CHI hien 'Enable LAN IPv6', an het Mode/PD Mode/ULA/DHCP
ipv6Settings.enabled=true -> hien Mode select (Stateful/Stateless) + toan bo khoi PD Mode + ULA
PD Mode: FormRadios Automatic/Manual; mode=Manual moi hien o 'Custom Delegated IPv6-Prefix'
ULA: 'Enable ULA' switch luon hien khi ipv6 enabled; o 'ULA IPv6-Prefix' LUON hien nhung disabled=!ula.enabled (khong an/hien, chi khoa nhap)
DHCP Server (IPv6): CHI hien khi mode===Stateful (Stateless thi an ca khoi, khong chi disable). Start/End IP Suffix disabled=!dhcp.enabled

Ban gia lap PHAI luon gui hai truong nay co dinh nhu vay trong PATCH dhcp/servers (giong ipVersion cua Static Routing: truong CLIENT tu tinh, khong phai o nhap).
